Hi team,

Quick handover for Auralis (deal RW-2026-AUR-41). High-level bullets so CS has the context up front: 
- ARR: $1.45M annual commit, 3-year term; signed 11/24/2026.
- Target go-live: 2027-01-31 (pilot -> full rollout).
- Primary contact: Emma Johns (EM, Auralis). Procurement on copy for billing/terms.
- Critical integrations: SAML SSO (Okta), Private VPC endpoint for inference traffic, customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest.
- Data residency: US-east primary, EU fallback for specific workflows (regulatory).
- Initial scope: hosted API with dedicated capacity for peak windows, embeddings for search, and a model pin to rwd-v2-7b-q8.

Attachments: Auralis_SOW_v3.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (shared link also below).

Top risks we flagged in sales:
- Security evidence (SOC2) needed before production acceptance window; procurement may request a full questionnaire.
- Networking folks will require a private endpoint runbook and test credentials.
- Timeline compression if SSO onboarding slips.

Requested CS asks:
1) Please confirm owners for kickoff and the 30/60/90 success milestones.
2) Please validate the SOW items and call out any scope gaps before we spin up infra.
3) Coordinate a 60-minute kickoff with Auralis and include an initial runbook review and SSO touchpoint.

Suggested owners (feel free to reassign):
- Onboarding lead: Tessa Morgan
- Security/compliance lead: Monica Patel
- Infrastructure/staging & go-live lead: Vivek Kulkarni

I can join the kickoff if helpful for exec-level alignment; otherwise I'll hand off.

Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
